name: Loud
description: Oversized hook words and a sound on every cut. For fast talking-head clips.
guidance: Open on a hookTitle with intro: true and at most two short words per line. Caption every spoken line at bottom 1750. Put a card on every beat, any tier, each on the word it echoes, and a slamStamp on each verdict. A sound effect lands on every cut. Still one message per card.
